name: no-uuid-and-device-type
description:
Two things this integration got wrong about its own records.

(1) A VirDomain row with no uuid killed the entire run. There was no `if not vid: continue` guard, so vid went straight to ImportAsset(id=None) and the runtime rejected it -- "id must be a string" -- with no exception to catch. Every VM already built was lost and NOTHING was reported. The row is the shape HC3 returns for a domain it is still writing or has partly deleted. vm-uuid-0201 is listed FIRST and the broken row second, so the failure cannot be mistaken for the run simply stopping early: under the old code 0201 was already built and was thrown away with the rest, and 0202 was never reached.

(2) Every asset here is a virtual machine, and none of them said so. /rest/v1/VirDomain is the only source of records and an HC3 VirDomain IS a guest VM, so the type is carried by the resource rather than guessed -- there is no case in which one of these assets is something else. It now matches what the other hypervisor sources in this repository emit for a guest (nutanix-prism, truenas, synology-dsm), so one search finds VMs across all of them.

namespaced_ids is skipped for the same reason as the happy scenario: the id is the bare HC3 VirDomain UUID with no cluster scope.

log_contains: scale-computing: skipped 1 VMs with no uuid (first name: vm-half-created)
